notes.title: 1.1.6 Update
notes.content:
Thank you again for your continued support of Siegecaster and for sharing its existence with your friends! 

This update includes a major change to the game based on post-launch feedback: A reduction in the level unlocked level required to merge your runes to the next tier. You'll now be able to merge two uncommon (green) runes to rare (blue) ones once you've unlocked level 3 (previously this was set to level 6). Rare runes can now be merged to epic (purple) upon unlocking level 6, and epic to legendary (orange) upon unlocking level 9. 

[h2]1.1.6[/h2]

[b]Major Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated Rare Runes to unlock at Level 3
[*] Updated Epic Runes to unlock at Level 6
[*] Updated Legendary Runes to unlock at Level 9
[*] New Demo based on 1.1.6 now available on store page
[/list]

[b]General and technical updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added auto-saving in case the game crashes
[*] Fixed graphical issue affecting Brain enemies
[*] Fixed Rune and Treasure Orc death animations lingering beyond intended 
[*] Updated Gold Rush Achievement description to more clearly state requirements
[*] Updated tutorial tilemap to fix enemies from getting stuck in trees
[*] Fixed shooting and entering build mode causing turrets to use ammo, but not fire
[*] Fixed game freezing for some users due to exception in SplineContainer.Finalize
[*] Fixed miscellaneous null reference exception in ConditionVisuals.UpdateAtlasUVs
[*] Fixed miscellaneous null reference exception in SpawnerWaves.SpawnAsync
[*] Updated Graphics Settings to disable stripping for Instancing Variants and BatchRenderGroup Variants
[*] Updated Graphics API for Windows to use Direct3D11 instead of Automatic (Direct3D12)
[/list]


[b]Continued known issue:[/b]

[list]
[*] Selection scrolls up indefinitely causing game to endlessly cycle through the turrets
[/list]

[b]Suggestion[/b]: Please ensure non-standard peripherals are not plugged in, this includes guitars, driving wheels and other unconventional input devices.

Thanks for your continued feedback on Discord and in the Steam Forums!

- The Siegecaster Team

notes.title: Siegecaster - One Week Later
notes.content:
First, a huge THANK YOU! ːsteamthumbsupː from the team on Siegecaster's first week out in the wilds, taking on the sneaky bugs that made it through testing. With that said...

1.1.4 is LIVE - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3138350/view/517461245625894253?l=english]Details here[/url].

We're currently doing internal testing on our next patch, which should catch some even sneakier bugs that got past our fortifications. 

If you're reading this and - hopefully, since you are - enjoyed the game, please consider giving us one of those lovely ːsteamthumbsupː reviews. Siegecaster is small enough that we aren't going to get any help beyond a positive response and word-of-mouth. Oh yeah, if you like Siegecaster, have you told a friend about it or posted about it on your social platform of choice? That helps us, too!

We're currently updating our Siegecaster demo, which should be live soon. Feel free to share it once it is! We know many of you picked up the game after your experience with the demo or open beta, so we plan on having a new demo out soon. 

Our challenge with Siegecaster is just getting folks to try it. Once they do, the majority like it! 

That's all for now. Siegecaster is now beginning its long campaign of making folks aware of its existence, and we appreciate everything you can do to help us make that happen!

SIEGE THE DAY!

- The Siegecaster Team
